name: learn
description: Learn any subject with an AI tutor that tracks what you actually know. A shared learner model replays graded evidence into mastery, review schedules (FSRS) and a frontier; skills set goals, place the learner, plan sessions, tutor Socratically with hint ladders, grade against objective checks and evaluate their own pedagogy. First subject pack: cyber resilience (SOC, SIEM, NDR), with synthetic labelled logs and Sigma detection grading.
